AMTS / MTS.dsaDepth: Heavy - one LeetCode-style DSA round plus HLD, and OOP/DBMS-focused technical rounds
rounds: Online coding assessment (DSA and problem-solving) for some pipelines
Technical round 1: DSA (a LeetCode-hard problem, e.g. DFS-based, is reported for some loops)
Technical round 2: high-level design emphasizing scalability and reliability, or DBMS/OOP/project discussion for other pipelines
Hiring-manager round: teamwork, problem solving, career goals
extraTopics: System scalability and reliability trade-offs in the design round
AMTS / MTS.notes: Loop composition varies noticeably by pipeline: some reports show 3 rounds (coding, HLD, HM), others show 4 (assessment + 2 technical + HR).
